observation.command:
cd /tmp
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"AdminLocalPassw0rd!"}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ | sed -n 's/.*"access":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
echo "token len: ${#TOKEN}"
for ep in projects node trench cable conduit fiber; do
  echo -n "$ep: "; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://api.localhost/api/v1/$ep/"
done
echo "=== projects content ==="; curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.localhost/api/v1/projects/" | head -c 800
